text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Ardan's next race fast approaching,
she and I are spending our
days training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My time went down, didn't it? My
breathing doesn't feel as ragged as
before
either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now then... I shall get back to
practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Ardan's in practice mode, nothing
can shake her out of it, not
even praise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A... weapon? Ah, my apologies. I
appreciate the compliment—I've just
never
thought about it like that before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's unaware of the effects her
determination has had on
her and her
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you know, I was born with a
fragile, weak body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do not know when my body will give out
on me. Among the
countless Umamusume
who shine so bright, my star may very well
burn
out the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just like that painting in the woods, I may
fade away and be
forgotten. And yet, here
and now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I still wish to shine, and I'm willing to do
whatever it takes to do so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as she spoke about her own
circumstances, Mejiro Ardan's eyes
burned
with a quiet... yet firm determination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm ready, Trainer. Please time my last lap.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How many laps does that
make? She's doing a lot of exercises...
Will
she be okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can hear the voice of Ardan's anxious
juniors. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... So far, so good...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Is everything all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I... I would love that, actually. I was just
thinking that I wanted to run
a little more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today. I feel like today's
training was especially fruitful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In addition, I was wondering... Perhaps we
could use today's
increased practice
regimen going forward?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Ehehe, I should be grateful. As I
am now, I don't have to worry
about
overheating anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Before my debut, there were times where I
could not practice for days
at a time. I'm
glad to know that's all in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, our post-training meeting ends
on an optimistic note. Yet
despite the fact
that the day's over, Ardan's posture
remains as
composed as ever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but I feel more at ease like
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Racers in the Mejiro family make a lot of
public appearances, so we're
taught how
to conduct ourselves from a very young
age. And, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ardan? Why are you over here, all by your
lonesome? You're leaning
against the
wall... Are you feeling sick?

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, ma'am. I was just thinking to myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Friend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't push yourself. You have
to be mindful of your health!

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Oh... If I relax too much, others will think
I'm sick...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies. In any case, I feel more
relaxed like this, so you
needn't worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I promised you I wouldn't overdo
it, correct? I assure you, I
am fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I don't know if spoiling me like
that is such a good idea,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps tomorrow I will skip practice
simply because I feel like it.
What will you
do then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... And that's exactly what I'm hoping
for. But thank you for your
concern. I
promise I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she smiles, I feel my own desire to
further protest melt away. It
seems even I
am no match for Mejiro Ardan's stubborn
determination.
